title: RTX 5080 and RTX 3090 Setup: 80 Tok/s on Qwen 3.6 27B Q8
summary: A practical guide demonstrating how to achieve 80+ tokens per second inference speed on the Qwen 3.6 27B model with Q8 quantization by combining an RTX 5080 with an RTX 3090 in a dual-GPU setup.
problem_solved: Enables high-throughput local LLM inference by leveraging multi-GPU parallelism for running large quantized models
why_valuable: Provides a cost-effective solution for running large language models locally with near-realtime performance
